name: Oysters à la Astor
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Wash and pick over oysters, parboil, drain, and to liquor add enough water to make one cup liquid; then strain through cheese-cloth.
Cook butter, shallot, and pepper three minutes, add flour, and pour on gradually, while stirring constantly, oyster liquor.
Remove oysters to small pieces of bread sautéd in butter on one side.
Pour sauce over oysters and garnish with thin slices of cucumber pickles.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
